8a3('bum): chub sems dpa' sems dpal chen po rnams kyi pha rolatu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yi te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ko'u shi ka de ni 'di ltarabartson 'grus kyi pha rolatu phyin pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmi gas/phyi 
8a4('bum): ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/da bus mi dmigs so//ko 'u shi ka bsam gtan gyi pha rolatu phyin pa'i sngon kyi mtha' mi dmigs/phyi ma mtha' mi dmigs/dbus ma dmigs so//ko'u shi kA shes rab kyi 
8a5('bum): yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na ko'u shi ka de ni 'di ltar/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon gyi mtha'ami dmigs/phyi ma'i mtha'ami dmigs/dbus mi dmigs so//ko'ushi ka shes rab kyi 
8a6('bum): pha rol tu phyin pa rgya che ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dang pa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'adi rgya che ba yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ke'u shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon
8a7('bum): gyi mtha' mi dmigs/phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/dbusami dmigs so//ko'u shi ka nang stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/byang chu ba sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha ral tu phyin pa 'di rgya
8a8('bum): che ba yin te/de ci'i phyiro zhe na/ke'u shi ka de na 'di ltar nang stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/phyi pa'i mtha' mi dmigs/dbu mi dmigs so//ke'u shi ka phyi stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyer/
8b1('bum): byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ko'u shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/phyi ma'i mtha' mi 
8b2('bum): dmigs/dbus mi dmigs so//ko'u shi ka phyi nang stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems/dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha ril tu phyin pa 'di rgya che pa yin te/de ci'i phyir zhes na/ko'u 
8b3('bum): shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi gta' mi dmigs/phyi ma'i mtha'i mi dmigs/dbus mi dmigs/so//ko'u shi ka stong pa nyid stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyer/byang chub sems dpa'
8b4('bum): sems dpa' chen po rnams gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgyu che ba yin te/de ci'i phyer zhe na/ko'u shi ka de de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi phye mtha' mi dmigs/phyi ma mtha' mi dmigs/dbus 
8b5('bum): mi dmigs so//ko'u shika chen po stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i ba'i phyir/byang chub sem dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnamasakyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ko'u shi ka de ni 'di ltar
8b6('bum): chen po stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/phyi ma'i ma tha' mi dmigs/dbus mi da mi gas so//ko'u shi ka don dam pa stong ba nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa'i sems dpa' chen po
8b7('bum): rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di/rgya che ba yin te/de ci yi phyir zhe na/ko'u shi ka da ni 'di ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi tha mtha' mi dmigs/phyi ma' mtha' mi dmigs/dbus mid dmigs so//
8b8('bum): ko'u shi ka 'dus byas stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/byad chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pa rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin ba 'di rgya che ba yin te/do ci'i phyir zhe na/ko'u shig de ni 'di ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi

9a4('bum): mtha' las 'das pa stong ba nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs dbus mi dmigs so//ko 'u shi ka thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid rgya che ba' phyir byang chub sems

9a7('bum): yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ko'u shi ka de ni 'di ltar dor ba med pa stong ba nyid kyi sngon gyis mtha' mi dmigs/phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/dbus ma dmigs so//ko'u shi ka rang bzhin 
9a8('bum): stong ba nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/byang chub sems pa dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam sa kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'dirgya che ba yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe la/ko'u shi ka de ni 'di lta rang bzhin stong ba

9b3('bum): ko'u shi ka rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyer/byang chub sems dpa' soms dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin ba 'di rgya che ba yin te//de ci'i phyir zhe na/ko'u shi ka da ni 'di ltar 
9b4('bum): rang gi mtshan nyid stong ba nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi migs/phyi ma'i mtha' mi migs/dbus mi dmigs swo//ko'u shi ka ma dmigs ba stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyor/byang chub sems dpa' 
9b5('bum): chen po rnams kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yinate/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ko'u shri ka de ni 'di ltar mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' midags/phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/dbus 
9b6('bum): mi dmigs so//ko'u shi ka dngos po med pa stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa'ar sems dpa' chen po rnams gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/
9b7('bum): ko'u shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po med pa stong ba nyid kyi sngon gyi tha' mi dmigs/phyi ma'i mtha' mid migs/dbus mi dmigs so//ko'u shika ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid
